title: Making a Real World (Earth) map in RPG Maker MV

posts.author: ResearchNGames
posts.body:
Hey! I want to make the overworld map of my game to be just like earth's map, 256x128. I came up with a solution that I can have a parallax in the background and trace it out, but I'm running into a problem that each map gets tiled, I need it to stretch to full length and breadth of the map.
Does someone have any experience with parallax graphics and what can be done to solve this? The maps I've used are all in the ratio 2:1
Edit: Welp, I figured out the solution. I didn't know I missed out on this tiny detail but each pixel on the map is actually 48x48 pixels not 1x1, so I just resized my map and it worked! I do hope this post is of help to anyone else with a similar problem.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I did a huge map of my country before. It's very much possible.
I simply took the map, scaled it to the the right size (all tiles x 48x48 pixels) and use that in the background.

posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body: If you need some references, play Terranigma. The game recreated the real Earth world map in it.
